Looking at Table 1's "Factors Affecting Reserve Balances," the factor absorbing reserve funds that moved the most over the week ended July 29, 2026 was the **U.S. Treasury, General Account**, which increased by **+$81,153 million** (from the week ended July 22, 2026), rising to $910,776 million on a weekly-average basis (and to $970,442 million on the Wednesday level). This was the largest driver behind the overall increase in "Deposits with F.R. Banks, other than reserve balances" (+$89,088 million), which in turn was the main reason reserve balances fell by $77,579 million over the week.
